plugin.name: Total Overdose Widescreen Fix
ResX.description: Override rendering width. If either dimension is zero, use the desktop resolution. Requires a restart.
ResY.description: Override rendering height. If either dimension is zero, use the desktop resolution. Requires a restart.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the SCI and Deadline startup logos. The story intro and other videos still play. Requires a restart.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Keep the original aspect with black borders, crop to fill the screen, or stretch. Applies immediately.
